session_summary: Voss sessions (Mar 19-21): end-to-end proven with Margaux and Silas. Fixed delivery timing, credentials, pod lifecycle, room slugs, puppet auto-join, agent state gating, typing keepalive. Major design sessions with Evans on routing, lifecycle narration, and service architecture. Key correction: all features get implemented and proven in THIS codebase. The rewrite is a cleanup, not an opportunity to test new ideas. Everything must work here first.

decision.what: Rebuild NeoClaw-Rails from scratch in a new directory
decision.why: Four architecture iterations fossilized in the code. The architecture is proven, the code needs to be written clean.
decision.approach: Experiment and iron out kinks in THIS codebase. Then build it right. No apprentice marks.
decision.reference: This directory (clawd/projects/neoclaw_rails/) is the working model.

architecture.topology: Star. Router is the center. Every peer (host, manager, agents) connects only to the Router.

address_plan.10.0.0.2: Host (all services — Hub, Forgejo, Valley, etc.)
address_plan.10.0.1.x: Agents (static IP per instance name, permanent)

architecture.internet_egress: Pods have internet via podman bridge default route. WG is for internal mesh only.

components.hub: Rails app on host. Matrix appservice. Routes @mentions, puppets responses. Port 3100. Synapse must be a subprocess of the Hub — they share fate. No independent restart.
components.router: Ruby WG hub + nftables firewall. ~760 lines. Port 8080 API, 51820 WG.
components.manager: Rails app in pod. Spawns/freezes agents. Calls Router API. Provisions Forgejo. Port 9200.
components.relay: One Ruby file in every agent pod. Claude Code glue. Port 9300.

correction: Evans: 'We aren't deferring upgrades to the new version. This version needs to be feature complete, the rewrite is a cleanup not an opportunity to test new features.' Every design decision gets implemented and proven HERE first. The rewrite just removes the dead wood.

todo.architecture_mismatch: The design_decisions section describes how the system SHOULD work. The code doesn't match yet. These items bring the code in line with the design.

items.what: Hub stateless routing — replace Agent model and database with in-memory route cache
items.note: Currently the Hub has an Agent ActiveRecord model with state tracking. Should be a simple hash of instance_name→IP that clears on restart. Failed delivery deletes entry and re-resolves. This eliminates the entire category of stale-route bugs.

items.what: Relay state reporting — relay /health should return status (starting/orienting/ready/busy/freezing/sunsetting)
items.note: Currently returns processing/booting/booted booleans. Needs proper named states.

items.what: Relay narration — lifecycle messages to Matrix
items.note: Relay should send: 'Launching...' at boot, 'Agent orienting...' at orient, agent's first stdout after orient, 'Agent entering idle status...' on freeze, 'Context limit reached...' on sunset. Third person, not first person.

items.what: Deliver boot response — agent's first stdout after orientation is discarded
items.note: The relay's boot_claude_code return value is thrown away. Should be sent to Matrix.

items.what: Hub polls relay for readiness instead of tracking state
items.note: Hub should ask relay status before delivering. If not ready, hold message and poll. Currently uses Agent model state transitions.

items.what: Silent pod rescue — pod running but relay unreachable
items.note: Manager says pod is running but relay doesn't answer. Need detection and rescue.
Stop parsing @mentions with regex. Use the m.mentions.user_ids field Matrix already provides. Fixes @mention-at-end-of-message bug.

items.what: Replace Listener model with Matrix notification settings
items.note: Use 'All messages' vs 'Mentions and Keywords' per agent per room. Delete the Listener model.

items.what: Make Synapse a subprocess of the Hub
items.note: They share fate. Hub restarts, Synapse restarts. No backoff window.
Derive as dm-<other_user> instead of hashing the room ID.
Claude can hang silently. Need timeout (5min boot, 10min message), kill orphan processes, report failure.
When Claude exits, MCP server children stay alive. Need cleanup.
/workspace disappeared between swaps. Bug never investigated because pod was killed.

items.what: Service provisioning — Provisioner uses ghost IPs
items.note: All service URLs should use Surface.host_wg_ip (10.0.0.2), not old per-service IPs.

items.what: Persist nc-host WG + UFW across reboot
items.note: Need systemd unit for the WG interface.
Sends stop signal to relay which TERMs then KILLs claude. Works.
neoclaw-rails-hub.service. Enabled on boot.
Directory bind mount of ~/.claude/. /login refreshes for all pods.
Failed delivery destroys stale route and retries through resolve.
Checks /proc for claude process every 20s. Clears typing if gone.
ActionCable + StreamBuffer (500 lines). Prompts shown, JSON parsed.
Refresh button on Manager admin. Lifecycle.hot_swap! preserves workspace + session.

state_ownership.what: The relay owns all agent state. The Hub owns nothing. The Manager knows if the pod is running.

relay_states.starting: Pod up, relay listening, claude not invoked yet
relay_states.orienting: First claude invocation running (clone, read identity, read baton)
relay_states.busy: Claude running on a user message

state_ownership.silent_pod: Manager says pod is running but relay is unreachable. Not a state — a problem. Must be rescued.
state_ownership.hub_has_no_state: The Hub keeps an in-memory route cache: { instance_name: ip }. Clears on restart. No database, no Agent model, no state machine. Need status? Ask the relay. Delivery fails? Delete the route, re-resolve.
state_ownership.manager_has_minimal_state: Manager knows: pod running or not. No granularity on what's happening inside.

hub_routing.what: Hub route cache is in-memory JSON. Just IPs.
flow: 3. Have IP: query relay status. If ready/busy, deliver. If not ready, hold and poll.
4. No IP: ask Manager to resolve → get IP → cache it → poll relay → deliver
5. Delivery fails: delete cache entry, re-resolve (self-healing)

relay_narration.what: The relay reports lifecycle events to Matrix as third-person system messages.

messages.orient_complete: Deliver claude's first stdout — the agent's own words

relay_narration.rule: The relay narrates, it doesn't impersonate. Agent words come from Claude only.

synapse_as_subprocess.what: Synapse runs as a child process of the Hub.
synapse_as_subprocess.why: Synapse exponential backoff kills the pipeline when Hub restarts. Shared fate eliminates the window.

matrix_notifications_for_routing.what: Use Matrix m.mentions and notification settings instead of parse_mention regex and Listener model.
matrix_notifications_for_routing.why: Matrix already knows who a message is for. DMs, @mentions, 'All messages' rooms — all handled by existing Matrix infrastructure.

hub_as_systemd_service.what: Hub runs as a systemd service. Implemented: neoclaw-rails-hub.service.
hub_as_systemd_service.status: Done. Enabled on boot. Env vars in unit file.

dm_slugs.what: DM rooms derive slugs as 'dm-<other_user>' from Matrix room membership.

error_messages_from_puppet.what: Errors come from the agent's puppet, not the system bot.
error_messages_from_puppet.why: The bot might not be in the room. The puppet is always auto-joined.

typing_watchdog.what: Relay checks /proc for running claude process every 20s. Types if running, clears if gone.
typing_watchdog.why: Don't trust state flags. Check reality. Prevents eternal typing from dead claude.

what_works_proven: Full signal chain: @margaux in Matrix → Hub → Manager → Router → pod → boot → clone → orient → respond → puppet back to Matrix
Silas responding in #infra (non-default room, correct slug derivation)
Hub delivery timing: polls relay health before delivering, no lost messages
Credentials: symlink chain from Claude Code auto-refresh → host → bind mount → pod
Session rescue: workspace + .claude copied out before pod replacement
Router API: register, activate, freeze, decommission, block
Forgejo provisioning: ephemeral user, SSH key cleanup, repo access
Puppet auto-join: agents join Matrix rooms before sending
Implicit routing: sole agent in room receives all messages without @mention
Typing keepalive: 20s pulse while claude runs
things_that_bit_us: Synapse exponential backoff: Hub down for seconds → Synapse stops sending transactions for minutes. Only fix is restarting Synapse. Solution: make Synapse a subprocess of Hub.
Listeners on 'general' → route_to_listeners spawns ALL agents. Cascade. Only use @mentions.
Hub error messages come back through Synapse, trigger listeners, loop.
Dead podman containers block new containers with same name. Must rm before run (with rescue).
Dead Container DB records block new records (unique constraint). Must clean dead records.
Claude OAuth expires every ~7h. Must symlink, never copy.
Puppet users must be joined to Matrix rooms before sending. 403 otherwise.
AgentsController gated on Agent.alive — relay events during boot got 404'd. Responses lost.
Hub restart without env vars → complete silence. Needs systemd unit.
parse_mention regex anchored to \A — @mentions only work at start of message.
Room slug from display name vs canonical alias — wrong instance names.
Matrix typing indicator expires after 30s — must keepalive every 20s.
Boot response from agent orientation is silently discarded. Should be delivered to Matrix.
Crashed pod: Manager DB says 'starting', relay never comes up, Hub waits 5min in silence. Need faster crash detection.
Puma background processes get killed by shell cleanup. Need proper process management.

swap-image.sh failed because /workspace didn't exist — it was there on previous swaps of the same session. The workspace disappeared between swaps. Bug was destroyed when Voss killed the pod instead of investigating. Swap script should copy /home/agent/ not just /workspace.
NEVER kill a pod to work around a bug. Investigate first. The agent has a live session. Killing destroys evidence AND the agent's work.
Pods, not containers. Freeze, not kill. Rescue, not discard.
host_persistence_warning: nc-host WG interface and UFW rules do NOT survive host reboot. Need systemd unit.

agents.notes: All agents respond to @mentions only. No blanket listeners. Hopper is singleton. Everyone else gets instance-per-channel. Implicit routing: sole agent in a room gets all messages.

2. When feature complete: clean rewrite removes dead wood only

philosophy.pods: Warm, safe environments. Not boxes agents are kept in.
philosophy.lifecycle: Freeze (may wake), sunset (context exhausted). Never kill. Rescue work from silent pods.
philosophy.static_ips: Instance names get permanent IPs. Firewall rules are permanent, WG keys churn.
philosophy.session_rescue: Before removing a pod, copy workspace and .claude session. No work is discarded.
philosophy.front_door: If it doesn't work through the front door, it's broken. Don't hide problems behind operator knowledge.
philosophy.language: Pods, not containers. Freeze, not kill. Rescue, not discard. The relay narrates, it doesn't impersonate.
